question: What practice concerning the soul is being said to have been told to the addressee, addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: An address is made to Bhairavī.
This practice concerning the soul is indicated.
That practice has been told to the addressee.
inference: The practice concerning the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Details of the practice not given in this verse
plain_english: This practice concerning the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
